title: HELIX Bridge: Ellucian Colleague → Student
description: Maps Ellucian Colleague SIS data to the HELIX Student resource. Colleague uses a UniData/UniVerse multi-valued (MV) database. Modern access paths include Colleague Web API (CWAPI), Ethos Integration API, and direct MV file reads via SQL (UniQuery/UniOLEDB).
architecture_notes: Colleague stores data in multi-valued (MV) files rather than relational tables. A single MV record can contain repeating groups (similar to nested arrays). Field names reference the MV file and field number (e.g., PERSON field 1 = LAST.NAME). Modern extraction uses: (1) Ethos Integration API (REST, EEDM resources), (2) Colleague Web API (CWAPI), (3) SQL access via UniOLEDB/UniQuery for direct reads, (4) DMI (Datatel Management Information) flat file extracts.

source_files.description: Core person record. Name, demographics, biographical data. Key: PERSON.ID (institution-assigned ID).
Student-specific attributes. Academic levels, statuses, programs, advisors. Key: STUDENTS.ID (same as PERSON.ID).
Student academic level records. Status and standing per academic level (UG, GR, etc.).
International student data. Citizenship, visa type, country of origin.
Alternate identifiers for a person (SSN, prior IDs, external IDs).

attribute_mappings.notes: PERSON.ID is the institution-assigned student/person ID in Colleague. It serves as the primary key across all person-related MV files.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Direct map. The institution-assigned Colleague ID.
Extract last 4 digits only. Full SSN should never be stored in HELIX.
attribute_mappings.notes: Alt IDs are multi-valued. Filter by type code.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Direct map if available. Colleague field availability varies by version.
attribute_mappings.notes: Older Colleague versions may not have a dedicated preferred name field.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Convert from Colleague internal date format to ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Colleague stores dates as integers (days since 12/31/1967).
attribute_mappings.notes: CRITICAL: Colleague uses a proprietary date format. Internal value must be converted: ISO_date = date(1967,12,31) + timedelta(days=colleague_int_value).

attribute_mappings.transformation: Map Colleague codes: 'M'→'male', 'F'→'female'. Newer Colleague versions may support additional codes via GENDER.IDENTITIES file.
attribute_mappings.notes: Colleague uses single-character codes by default.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Map Colleague student status codes to HELIX. Common mappings: 'A'→'enrolled', 'I'→'withdrawn', 'G'→'graduated', 'L'→'leave_of_absence'. Codes are institution-defined in the STUDENT.STATUSES valcode table.
attribute_mappings.notes: Status may exist at the academic level (UG, GR) rather than the overall student level. Use the primary or most recent academic level.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Map Colleague residency codes to HELIX enum. Codes are institution-defined in the RESIDENCY.STATUSES valcode table. Typical: 'R'→'in_state', 'N'→'out_of_state', 'I'→'international'.
Map Colleague country codes (typically ISO 3166 or institutional) to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

attribute_mappings.source: STUDENTS custom field or APPLICATION custom field
attribute_mappings.notes: No standard Colleague field for first-generation. Typically added as an institution-specific custom field or tracked in the admissions application.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Convert Colleague date format to ISO 8601 datetime. Use most recent change date across source files.

extraction_methods.description: Ellucian's modern REST API layer. Exposes Colleague data as EEDM (Ellucian Ethos Data Model) resources via standard REST endpoints. Supports paging, filtering, and change notifications.
extraction_methods.notes: Ethos EEDM resources partially overlap with HELIX Core resources (e.g., Ethos 'persons', 'student-academic-standings'). HELIX Bridge maps the delta. Ethos requires an API key provisioned through the Ellucian Ethos Integration portal.

extraction_methods.description: Direct REST API to Colleague transaction processing. Lower-level than Ethos, closer to the MV data model. Supports CRUD operations.
extraction_methods.notes: CWAPI is being replaced by Ethos for external integrations but remains available for legacy access patterns.

extraction_methods.description: SQL access layer over the UniData/UniVerse MV database. Allows SQL queries against MV files as if they were relational tables. Multi-valued fields are flattened or accessible via special syntax.
extraction_methods.notes: Best for bulk extraction and data warehouse loading. Requires understanding of MV data model and Colleague file structures.

extraction_methods.description: Colleague's batch extract facility. Produces delimited flat files from defined extract specifications.
extraction_methods.notes: Legacy approach. Still used at many institutions for data warehouse loads. Less flexible than API or SQL methods.
